The '''2018–19 Côte d'Ivoire Ligue 1''' is the 60th season of the [[Ligue 1 (Ivory Coast)|Côte d'Ivoire Ligue 1]], the top-tier [[association football|football]] league in the [[Ivory Coast]] (Côte d'Ivoire), since its establishment in 1960. The season started on 7 September 2018.<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesi/ivo2019.html Ivory Coast 2018/19], RSSSF.com</ref>
